public_body: Mashpee Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by barring the complainant from in-person meetings under a no trespass notice without providing remote access, ordering remote access and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleges the Board barred him from attending open meetings in person under a no trespass notice, with no alternative means of attendance.
allegations.key_passage: For this reason, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Board contends the complainant's conduct posed a safety threat justifying exclusion from meetings held at a Housing Authority property.
allegations.key_passage: That concern satisfies the Law’s requirement that exclusion from a meeting occur only in the face of a reasonable and imminent fear for personal safety.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleges the Executive Director has 'weaponized' security cameras at the Housing Authority.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review allegations that fall outside of the Open Meeting Law, including the allegation that Executive Director Conn has “weaponized” security cameras at the Housing Authority.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.

Provide remote access to the complainant to all open Board meetings held more than 30 days after the date of the letter, with access comparable to in-person attendees, including public comment where available to in-person attendees.
remedy_passage: We also order the Board to provide remote access to the complainant to all open Board meetings held more than 30 days after the date of this letter.
